title: Skyjacked Oilrig: The Braided Teen's Gambit
summary: Deep within the chaotic, inky trenches, new recruits grapple with the nerves of a royal, unworthy quest. They navigate economic logging operations, avoiding a massive watersnake and jacked caves. Our protagonist, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, executes a desperate kickflip. A flashback reveals a shadowy limbo figure and untold kidnaping. She's borne the weight of these hijacks, acknowledging the lacking data. Her hand reaches for a cooled, jellied gelcap, her anthem against the packrat dealer's hackwork. An emergency, an oilrig skyjacked, the valkyr followed. As dawn breaks, she stands on the rig, no longer unsure. The underworld creeps scatter, a slowdown signaling peace. She's no longer obligated, maintaining a plucky stance, her ecdysis complete.
